Spec 047's draft (branch spec-047-roif-ledger-distribution-draft, PR #246; §4 read in full at this draft): Asset B's contract — file form (§4.1), six classes and the groupings fixed 'for the test and for D-10's use' (§4.2), the two-source agreement and testable rules (§§4.3–4.4), freeze point and digest pinning with the consumer rule — dependents name the digest and re-assert it at step 0, mismatch stops the consumer as INVALID (§4.6).

alternatives: importing the sibling test's 12-site floor so a thin-but-honest asset closes both tests on one rule (refused at draft: the floors are design-specific; the freeze of either spec may align them openly)
falsification_tests: the gate-0.6 census is computed and published before any share; a run that computes a share past a failed floor falsifies compliance
